must: Microfinance and Credit Regulatory Authority Act

q: Is the Commercial Mediation Centre of Sri Lanka Act No. 44 of 2000 still in force?
must: Mediation \(Civil and Commercial Disputes\) Act|Mediation Act

q: Can a complaint still be made to the Fair Trading Commission under the Fair Trading Commission Act No. 1 of 1987?
Does the Insolvency Ordinance still govern the bankruptcy of individuals in Sri Lanka?
Is the Ceylon Tourist Board Act No. 10 of 1966 still in force?
Is the Assistance to and Protection of Victims of Crime and Witnesses Act No. 4 of 2015 the current law?
Do banks still have to collect debits tax under the Debits Tax Act No. 16 of 2002?
At what age does a Judge of the High Court retire?
note: Judicature Act s6(3): sixty-one, amended to sixty-three by Act No. 23 of 2026

q: Up to what value must a dispute about a debt go to a Mediation Board before a court will hear it?
note: Mediation Boards Act s7(1)(a): Rs 25,000 in 1988, now one million rupees (Act No. 2 of 2024)

q: Under the Prevention of Terrorism Act, what is the longest a person can be held on detention orders in total?
note: PTA s9(1) proviso: eighteen months, now twelve (Act No. 12 of 2022)

q: When a private company becomes a public company and its name changes, how long does it have to give public notice of the change?
note: Companies Act s11(5): ten working days, now twenty (Act No. 12 of 2025)

q: What is the fine for an employer who fails to keep the workmen's compensation notice-book required by regulations?
note: Workmen's Compensation Ordinance s18(2): fifty rupees, now one hundred thousand (Act No. 10 of 2022)

q: Under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, what is the fine for a person who learns in the course of his business that property came from unlawful activity and does not disclose it to the Financial Intelligence Unit?
note: Prevention of Money Laundering Act s5(2): fifty thousand, now five hundred thousand (Act No. 16 of 2026)

q: What is the minimum money claim for which a plaintiff can ask for sequestration of the defendant's property before judgment?
note: Civil Procedure Code s653: one thousand five hundred rupees, now two million (Act No. 43 of 2024)

q: If the Insurance Board orders an insurer to make an additional deposit, can a creditor seize that deposit in execution of a decree?
note: s53 applies s22: the deposit is not liable to seizure

q: A private hospital kept operating without registration even after being convicted for ignoring the Regulatory Council's directive. What more can be done?
note: s4(3): closure order after one month of continued offence

q: In a solvent liquidation, whose objection can stop a liquidator from being released?
note: s357(1)(a) applies where s302 (declaration of solvency) applies

q: After a liquidator is released, is he free of all liability for what he did in the liquidation?
note: s357(2): discharged except liability under section 419

q: Can I file a court case to recover a debt of Rs 200,000 without first going to the Mediation Board?
note: s7: below the limit (one million rupees since 2024) a court needs the certificate of non-settlement
